about_short_description.short_description: Fiverr is a freelance services center that offers a marketplace for creative and professional services.

product.name: Fiverr Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace where clients purchase freelance creative, technical, marketing, business, and professional services from independent freelancers across more than 700 categories.

product.name: Fiverr Pro
product.description: A business-oriented Fiverr offering that provides access to curated freelance talent, managed hiring options, project management, and team-based delivery for professional projects.

product.name: Expert Sourcing Service
product.description: A managed talent-sourcing service in which Fiverr experts identify, interview, and vet freelancers, then provide clients with a curated shortlist and recommendations.

product.name: Freelance Project Management Service
product.description: A managed service in which Fiverr-selected project managers coordinate freelancers and oversee delivery of larger creative, marketing, technology, and other business projects.

product.name: Programming & Tech Services
product.description: Freelance development and technology services covering websites, software, mobile apps, AI systems, integrations, cybersecurity, cloud operations, testing, and technical support.

product.name: Graphics & Design Services
product.description: Freelance visual design services for logos, branding, websites, architecture, books, illustrations, presentations, packaging, and other digital or physical design needs.
